classification.difficultyReason: Express unknown angles algebraically using straight lines, parallel lines, triangle properties and quadrilateral angle sums.

content.prompt: Find the marked angle $\angle AOB$ in terms of $\theta$, giving reasons.

spec.description: Straight line BOP and ray OA; marked angle AOB.
spec.mathematics: B,O,P collinear; theta is angle AOP.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle AOB+\theta&=180^\circ\\\angle AOB&=180^\circ-\theta\end{align*}$$
Adjacent angles on a straight line are supplementary.

spec.description: Triangle OCB with exterior angle AOB and AOC straight.

answer.worked:
$$\angle AOB=\theta+35^\circ$$
The exterior angle of $\triangle OBC$ equals the sum of the two opposite interior angles.

spec.description: Triangle AOB, with OB extended through B to C.
spec.mathematics: Angle OAB=theta; exterior angle ABC=80 degrees.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle AOB+\theta&=80^\circ\\\angle AOB&=80^\circ-\theta\end{align*}$$
Use the exterior angle of $\triangle AOB$ at $B$.

spec.description: Parallel oblique lines PA and YX crossed by horizontal OB.
spec.mathematics: PA parallel YX; theta and AOB are co-interior angles.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle AOB+\theta&=180^\circ\\\angle AOB&=180^\circ-\theta\end{align*}$$
Co-interior angles are supplementary because $AP\parallel XY$.

spec.description: Triangle AOB with marked apex angle.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle AOB&=180^\circ-\theta-45^\circ\\\angle AOB&=135^\circ-\theta\end{align*}$$
The angles of $\triangle AOB$ sum to $180^\circ$.

spec.description: Quadrilateral MAOB with right angle at M.
spec.mathematics: Interior angles at A and B both theta; angle M=90 degrees.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle AOB&=360^\circ-90^\circ-\theta-\theta\\\angle AOB&=270^\circ-2\theta\end{align*}$$
The interior angles of quadrilateral $AOBM$ sum to $360^\circ$.

spec.description: Isosceles triangle AOB with double ticks on OA and OB.

answer.worked:
$$\angle ABO=\theta$$
Base angles of isosceles $\triangle AOB$ are equal.
$$\begin{align*}\angle AOB&=180^\circ-\theta-\theta\\\angle AOB&=180^\circ-2\theta\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Isosceles triangle with double ticks on AO and AB.

answer.worked:
$$\angle ABO=\angle AOB$$
Base angles are equal because $AO=AB$.
$$\begin{align*}2\angle AOB&=180^\circ-\theta\\\angle AOB&=\frac{180^\circ-\theta}{2}\\\angle AOB&=90^\circ-\frac{\theta}{2}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Equilateral triangle BCO, straight COD and ray OA.
spec.mathematics: BC=BO=CO; angle AOD=theta; target angle BOA.

answer.worked:
$$\angle BOC=60^\circ$$
Triangle $BOC$ is equilateral.
$$\begin{align*}\angle AOB&=180^\circ-60^\circ-\theta\\\angle AOB&=120^\circ-\theta\end{align*}$$
Adjacent angles on straight line $COD$ sum to $180^\circ$.
